summary: winrm options for Kerberos (kinit command, managed or manual mode, kinit_args overriding defaults including -f for delegation, kinit_env_vars except KRB5CCNAME), URI path, and pipelining.
questions: Can Ansible obtain the Kerberos ticket for WinRM automatically?
How do I pass extra arguments to kinit for WinRM?
How do I get a forwardable Kerberos ticket for WinRM delegation?
How do I pass environment variables to kinit?
Can I use a Kerberos ticket I already obtained with kinit?

answer_card.title: winrm Kerberos options
answer_card.answer_md:
- `kerberos_mode`: `managed` (Ansible gets the ticket) or `manual` (you already have one).
- `kerberos_command` (default `kinit`).
- `kinit_args` (2.11+): extra kinit args. By default none, except `-f` when `ansible_winrm_kerberos_delegation` is set. Setting this overrides defaults, including `-f`.
- `kinit_env_vars` (2.12+, default `[]`): env vars passed to kinit; `KRB5CCNAME` is not allowed.
- `path` (default `/wsman`), `pipelining` (default false).
